facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform launched the new version of the national portal of administrative procedures Idarati on 18 September 2026, per analyst Slimane El Omrani.
The relaunched Idarati portal gives access to 874 public e-services (the article elsewhere says 784), up from 605 at the end of 2023 per the Court of Audit, according to analyst Slimane El Omrani.
